LEVITATE (*Societal Level Impacts of Connected and Automated Vehicles*) developed a framework and methods to assess and forecast the impacts of connected and automated transport systems on individuals, the mobility system and society. The results were integrated into a web-based Policy Support Tool that helps cities and authorities to evaluate measures against their policy objectives.

At AIT, I developed a system dynamics (SD) model that forecasts the systemic and wider impacts of connected and automated mobility over long time horizons. The model was integrated into the Policy Support Tool.
